name: cbb_v1_split_v1
rule: Features for a game use only games with strictly earlier calendar dates (same-date atomic). Sigma and coefficients fit on the fit window only. Nothing here authorizes inspecting the protected window.

validation_window.note: 2024-25 season + 2025 postseason. Input/feature selection happens ONLY against this window. It is never described as a final independent test.

protected_final_test.note: 2026 postseason including the NCAA tournament. FINAL TEST. Must never be loaded for fitting, selection, or evaluation until the one-time final run. The code hard-gates these rows out unless --unlock-final-test is passed; that flag is reserved for the single final evaluation.

current_season_prospective.note: 2026-27 in-season results accumulate via the daily durable collector; reported separately as prospective.

retrospective_holdout.note: 2025-26 regular season. RETROSPECTIVE held-out test at best (outcomes already exist; not a genuine future frozen forecast). Not used for feature selection; scored only after model choices are fixed and audits complete.
